CustomField.label: Property St Number
CustomField.description: Street number component of the property address, split out from Property_Address__c. Requested by Niraj 2026-07-29 for the PAL/ROE acquisition refocus so the on-net MDU list can be sorted and grouped by street.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Just the street number (e.g. 1015). The rest of the address is in Property Street.
